note: The town's planning rules for the building designer (docs/specs/domains/BUILDER.md BUILD-006, BUILD-007; Q-34 decided 2026-11-22: each district offers only its own palette). Checked by Tools/citysim/builder.py. Each district's palette is what its buildings have today, so the town's own designs all pass; a new choice joins a palette only with an ADR and the owner's approval (the look is locked, ADR-0004). Colours are given by their place in building_kit.json's lists; stone and brick by their name in surfaces.json. 'remodel' lists what a level-1 remodel may change (F-BLD-DESIGN level 1): everything else in a design stays as it is. 'outside' parts need the whole building; 'inside' parts need the unit on that floor (ADR-0022 units).
